2: The LORD hear you in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend you;
3: Send you help from the sanctuary, and strengthen you out of Zion;
4: Remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice; Selah.
5: Grant you according to your own heart, and fulfill all your counsel.
6: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfill all your petitions.
7: Now know I that the LORD saves his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
8: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
9: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
10: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
